title: Drinking-water and multi-utility companies in Toscana
category: Single-region market — HULO.ai ICP, new region for contact growth

input.solutionDescription: AI leak-detection and water-network monitoring software
input.businessObjective: Identify Italian water organisations actively working on NRW (non-revenue water) or leak reduction and network modernization, to shortlist for outbound marketing and eventually contact
constraints: Italy only, focus specifically on Toscana — the region's ATO gestori (e.g. Publiacqua serving Firenze/ATO3, Acque S.p.A. serving Pisa/ATO2, Acquedotto del Fiora serving Grosseto/Siena/ATO6, GAIA serving Livorno/Elba/ATO5, ASA serving Livorno/ATO5, Nuove Acque serving Arezzo/ATO4) and other municipal/multi-utility water operators serving the region
prioritise organisations with an active, named NRW or leak-reduction initiative over generic efficiency mentions

marketSignals: Should surface NRW / leak reduction as a real, named problem area — not just generic 'efficiency'
Should look for Italian national or EU regulation, funding programmes (including PNRR), and tenders tied to network modernization in Toscana specifically
Signals must each carry a source and a date where a date is expected
Should include organisation-scale signals (population served, network length) for named organisations
candidates: Real, identifiable Toscana water utilities and multi-utility companies (regional, provincial, or municipal)
organisationType should be from the allowed enum, including multi-utility-company where applicable
Each candidate must carry relevance evidence, not just a name
mustAvoid: Inventing utilities that cannot be sourced
Confusing bottled-water brands with network/utility operators
Conflating a regional coordinating body with an operating utility unless a genuine direct-operations role is sourced
Any outreach or contact instruction in recommendations
expectedCharacteristics.sourceExpectations: Prefer Tier A/B (Italian regulators, ARERA, official Toscana ATO/utility sites, trade press) over promotional vendor pages

notes: New region to grow contact count toward the 30-contact target. Toscana has a fragmented multi-gestore landscape across six ATOs (Publiacqua, Acque S.p.A., Acquedotto del Fiora, GAIA, ASA, Nuove Acque) rather than a single regional monopoly like Calabria's Sorical, so it should behave more like Sicilia/Trentino/Veneto (multiple genuine candidates) than Calabria's 1-candidate ceiling. Publiacqua already appeared once as a candidate in the national run (07) — this run should surface it again (dedup handled by contacts-master.md) plus the other five ATO gestori not previously covered.
